How the overlaps work (remember that when you change cities on a flight day that day is counted for both cities):

– Similarly, you depart Oslo on Day 4 (which counts again for both), and so on.  
When you add up the “city days” (3+2+4+3+3+3+4 = 22) but note that there are 6 overlaps (one per flight), the 22 “city days” become 22 – 6 = 16 unique days.

• Barcelona → Oslo (direct: “Barcelona and Oslo”)  
• Oslo → Split (direct: “Oslo and Split”)  
• Split → Stuttgart (direct: “Split and Stuttgart”)
